title: Quantum Zeno effect
source_locator: Table I, Physical Review A 41, 2295–2300 (1990), page 2298; 9Be+ trapped ions
measurement_description: Published 1->2 and 2->1 transition probability estimates for 1,2,4,8,16,32,64 optical measurement pulses
uncertainty_caution: Author describes ~0.02 scatter-derived uncertainty; not individual independent Gaussian standard errors; do not claim formal chi-square significance.
ideal_model_note: Ideal probability is 0.5*(1 - cos(pi/n)^n). This is transition probability, not survival; the original Ocean model's final P0 is 1 minus this.
paper_prediction_note: Authors' full prediction includes finite optical pulse duration and optical pumping; the ideal model omits both.
use_of_negative_observation: For n=64 forward 1->2, reported -0.006 is a noise-affected estimator, not a negative physical probability; do not clip or silently discard.
